title: Insulin Pump Program Coordination Note: Sensor Source and Pump Insulin
content:
Holding a Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program changes what an Insulin Pump Program may carry, and the pump program changes how pump insulin is supplied.

**Sensor source.** A pump program on a pump whose entry in the CGM program's pump compatibility list names CGM models uses the customer's CGM program as its sensor source, and the pump model written on the program must accept the CGM model on the customer's CGM program that is not closed. A MiniMed 780G program, whose list is empty, takes its sensors under this program.

**No duplicate sensor allowance.** A MiniMed 780G sensor refill (A4239) ships only when the customer holds no CGM program in active status, because a payer pays only one CGM supply allowance per month; a customer moving to the 780G ends or holds the CGM program first.

**Pump insulin on Original Medicare.** On the Insulin Pump Original Medicare Program the insulin used in the pump is a Part B benefit supplied with the pump, so the customer's pump insulin is dispensed under the Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program of the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program rather than under Part D.

| Customer's CGM program status | MiniMed 780G sensor refill |
|---|---|
| No CGM program | May ship |
| CGM program on hold or closed | May ship — none is in active status |
| CGM program active | Does not ship |
